title: Will Qing — personal homepage
description: A personal homepage for research, books, music, film, and things worth remembering.

sections.heading: Hi, I’m Will Qing.
sections.lede: I’m an undergraduate in Information Engineering at Shanghai Jiao Tong University, interested in how computation can help us understand physical systems.
sections.intro: My current research interests include optical computing, machine learning, and AI-based processing of physical signals. Outside research, I spend most of my time reading, listening to music, and, more recently, watching films.

sections.heading: Shelf
sections.intro: Reading, music, and film are the main things I keep returning to outside research. This is a small, unfinished record rather than a definitive list.

sections.intro: A few research and course projects I have worked on.

items.title: Optoelectronic sensing for digital pathology scanning
items.summary: Worked on optical modeling, joint optical–electronic training, and simulation for an optoelectronic front end that assesses image quality during pathology scanning.

items.title: Vision-based robotic grasping and sorting
items.summary: Used ACT and a LeRobot SO-101 arm to sort colored blocks, working on data collection, policy training, deployment, and robot integration.

items.title: Multi-view refrigerator-door angle estimation
items.summary: Used YOLOv8-Seg and multi-view triangulation to reconstruct a refrigerator door’s geometry and estimate its opening angle.

sections.heading: I’m still figuring out what deserves to stay here.
sections.body: That is part of the point. This site is not meant to prove that I have already become something. It is a place to leave a trail while I’m becoming it.
